core_obligations: (1) => (2): taking stalks at x is pulling back by (x, O_{X,x}) -> (X,O_X), so apply the tor-amplitude-pullback lemma (proof lines 12422-12426).

(2) => (1): stalks commute with tensor products, H^i(E  otimes ^L F)_x = H^i(E_x  otimes ^L F_x), and vanishing of a sheaf is checked on stalks; conclude tor amplitude in [a,b] (proof lines 12427-12444).
proof_roadmap: Stalks as pullback to a point.
difficulty_reason: Taking stalks is pullback along the point inclusion, giving (1) => (2); for the converse, stalks commute with derived tensor and exactness of stalks reduces the vanishing test to stalks.
